title: An invitation
summary: Invite someone and accept an invitation, wish someone a happy birthday, and say why you do something with لِـ + a verb.
intro: To say why you do something, put لِـ (li-, 'to, in order to') in front of a present verb ending in -a: سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى السُّوق لِأَشْتَرِيَ هَدِيَّة (I'll go to the market to buy a present). Today Layla invites her friends to her birthday party. To wish someone a happy birthday, say كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتَ بِخَيْر to a man and كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْر to a woman.
objectives: Invite a friend to a party with أَدْعُوكَ إِلَى…
Accept an invitation politely with بِكُلِّ سُرُور
Say why you go somewhere with لِـ + a verb ending in -a

realLife.title: Cards after the test
realLife.story: On Sunday, after the short test, Layla takes a pile of small cards out of her bag. They are invitations to her birthday party on Friday evening, and her mother is coming all the way from Beirut to bake the cake.

sentences.en: I'll go to the market to buy a present.
sentences.literal: I-will-go to the market so-that-I-buy a-present

mistakes.why: The verb after li- keeps the person: I go so that I buy, li-ashtariya. li-yashtariya means 'so that he buys'.

sentences.ar: تَدْعُوكَ لَيْلَى إِلَى حَفْلَةِ عِيدِ مِيلَادِهَا.
sentences.en: Layla is inviting you to her birthday party. (to a man)
sentences.literal: invites-you Layla to party-of feast-of her-birth

sentences.ar: نَحْتَفِلُ بِعِيدِ مِيلَادِ لَيْلَى يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة.
sentences.en: We're celebrating Layla's birthday on Friday.
sentences.literal: we-celebrate with-feast-of birth-of Layla day-of Friday

mistakes.why: In a chain of nouns (iḍāfa) only the last word can be definite: ʿīdi mīlādi Laylā, with no al- on mīlād.

sentences.ar: شُكْرًا عَلَى الدَّعْوَة، سَآتِي بِكُلِّ سُرُور.
sentences.en: Thank you for the invitation; I'll come with pleasure.
sentences.literal: thanks for the invitation, I-will-come with-all pleasure

sentences.en: I've come to invite you to a party. (to a man)

dialogue.title: Layla's birthday
dialogue.culture: On a birthday, at Eid and at New Year people say كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتَ بِخَيْر, 'may you be well every year'. The polite answer is وَأَنْتَ بِخَيْر (and you too). When you are invited to someone's home, it is normal to bring something small: sweets, flowers or a little present. Arriving a little late is common, but not an hour late!

lines.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا شَبَاب! كَيْفَ كَانَ اِمْتِحَانُ الْيَوْم؟ أَنَا كَتَبْتُ كُلَّ الْأَجْوِبَة، لٰكِنَّهُ كَانَ صَعْبًا قَلِيلًا.
lines.en: Hi, guys! How was today's test? I wrote all the answers, but it was a bit difficult.

lines.ar: كَانَ سَهْلًا! وَأَنْتَ يَا دَانْيَال؟ تَبْدُو مُتْعَبًا قَلِيلًا بَعْدَ رِحْلَتِنَا إِلَى الْأَهْرَام.
lines.en: It was easy! And you, Daniel? You look a bit tired after our trip to the pyramids.
segs: you look, you seem (to a man)

lines.ar: نَعَم، مَشَيْنَا كَثِيرًا أَمْسِ، لٰكِنَّهُ كَانَ يَوْمًا رَائِعًا. يَا لَيْلَى، مَا هٰذِهِ الْبِطَاقَات فِي يَدِكِ؟
lines.en: Yes, we walked a lot yesterday, but it was a wonderful day. Layla, what are these cards in your hand?

lines.ar: هٰذِهِ دَعَوَات! يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة عِيدُ مِيلَادِي، وَأُرِيدُ أَنْ أَدْعُوَكُمَا إِلَى حَفْلَة صَغِيرَة فِي بَيْتِي.
lines.en: These are invitations! Friday is my birthday, and I'd like to invite you both to a small party at my home.

lines.ar: كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْر يَا لَيْلَى! شُكْرًا عَلَى الدَّعْوَة، طَبْعًا سَنَأْتِي بِكُلِّ سُرُور.
lines.en: Many happy returns, Layla! Thanks for the invitation; of course we'll come, with great pleasure.
segs: well ('kullu ʿāmin wa-anti bi-khayr': many happy returns)

lines.ar: نَعَم، سَنَأْتِي! وَمَتَى تَبْدَأُ الْحَفْلَة؟ وَمَا عُنْوَانُكِ؟ أَنَا لَا أَعْرِفُ أَيْنَ تَسْكُنِينَ.
lines.en: Yes, we'll come! And when does the party start? And what's your address? I don't know where you live.

lines.ar: تَبْدَأُ فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة مَسَاءً. وَالْعُنْوَان مَكْتُوب عَلَى الْبِطَاقَة: فِي الزَّمَالِك، قَرِيب مِنْ بُرْجِ الْقَاهِرَة.
lines.en: It starts at seven in the evening. And the address is written on the card: in Zamalek, near the Cairo Tower.
segs: Zamalek (district of Cairo on an island in the Nile)

lines.ar: وَمَنْ سَيَأْتِي أَيْضًا؟ هَلْ دَعَوْتِ الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم وَطُلَّابَ الصَّفّ؟
lines.en: And who else is coming? Did you invite Mr Karim and the other students in our class?

lines.ar: نَعَم، دَعَوْتُ الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم، وَسَيَأْتِي بَعْضُ أَصْدِقَائِي مِنْ لُبْنَان. سَيَكُونُ عِنْدَنَا خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ ضَيْفًا تَقْرِيبًا.
lines.en: Yes, I invited Mr Karim, and some of my friends from Lebanon will come. We'll have about fifteen guests.

lines.ar: وَمَاذَا نُحْضِرُ مَعَنَا؟ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى الْمَخْبَز لِأَشْتَرِيَ كَعْكَة كَبِيرَة.
lines.en: And what should we bring with us? I can go to the bakery to buy a big cake.

lines.ar: لَا، شُكْرًا! أُمِّي سَتَأْتِي مِنْ بَيْرُوت لِتَصْنَعَ الْكَعْكَة بِنَفْسِهَا، مَعَ الشُّمُوع طَبْعًا.
lines.en: No, thanks! My mother is coming from Beirut to make the cake herself, with candles of course.

lines.ar: إِذَنْ أَنَا وَدَانْيَال سَنَذْهَبُ إِلَى خَانِ الْخَلِيلِيّ لِنَشْتَرِيَ لَكِ هَدِيَّة صَغِيرَة.
lines.en: Then Daniel and I will go to Khan el-Khalili to buy you a small present.
segs: Khan (part of the market's name; lit. inn)

lines.ar: لَا تَشْتَرِيَا شَيْئًا غَالِيًا، مِنْ فَضْلِكُمَا! أَهَمُّ شَيْء أَنْ تَأْتِيَا وَتَحْتَفِلَا مَعِي.
lines.en: Don't buy anything expensive, please, you two! The most important thing is that you come and celebrate with me.

lines.ar: اِتَّفَقْنَا! سَنَكُونُ عِنْدَكِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة، وَلَنْ نَتَأَخَّرَ هٰذِهِ الْمَرَّة!
lines.en: Agreed! We'll be at your place on Friday at seven o'clock, and we won't be late this time!

reading.title: The invitation card
reading.ar: عَزِيزِي دَانْيَال، أَدْعُوكَ إِلَى حَفْلَةِ عِيدِ مِيلَادِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة مَسَاءً. الْحَفْلَة فِي بَيْتِي فِي الزَّمَالِك. سَتَكُونُ هُنَاكَ كَعْكَة وَمُوسِيقَى وَأَصْدِقَاء كَثِيرُونَ. أَرْجُو أَنْ تَأْتِيَ! لَيْلَى
reading.en: Dear Daniel, I'm inviting you to my birthday party on Friday at seven in the evening. The party is at my home in Zamalek. There will be cake, music and lots of friends. I hope you can come! Layla
segs: Zamalek (district of Cairo on an island in the Nile)
you come (after an, to a man)

quiz.prompt: What is Layla celebrating on Friday?
Fill the gap: 'We'll go to the market to buy a present.'
What do you say to a woman on her birthday?
In a yes/no question such as هَلْ سَتَأْتِي؟, what does the voice do at the end?

completion: Lovely! You can invite people, accept an invitation and say why you do things with لِـ. Next: the weather.
